none: PAS NLM-9C32C9: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Trier mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: possibly CONST[---]VS AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLOR]IA EXERCITVS. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 14.7mm, Weight: 1.20gms, die axis: 6
